mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT sigungu_code FROM public.sd_area_code WHERE sido_code = '11' AND level = 'SIGUNGU' AND sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND sigungu_code != '' AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sigungu_code

SELECT area_code FROM ( SELECT c.area_code, CASE WHEN c.area_code = #{apiAreaCode} THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{apiAreaCode} THEN 1 WHEN LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 1, 5) THEN 2 WHEN LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{apiAreaCode} THEN 3 WHEN LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 1, 8) THEN 4 WHEN LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 1, 5) THEN 5 ELSE 9 END AS match_priority FROM public.sd_area_code c WHERE c.is_active = TRUE AND ( c.area_code = #{apiAreaCode} OR ( LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{apiAreaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 1, 5) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{apiAreaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 1, 8) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{apiAreaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{apiAreaCode}, 1, 5) ) ) ) candidates ORDER BY match_priority, area_code LIMIT 1
